accessibility.evidence: Native labelled controls and aria-pressed journal/community buttons verified. Tab shows visible focus under reduced motion; no artificial device chrome. Photos have a dark scrim beneath white titles. Primary place save and planning actions verified.

responsive.evidence: Six screens rendered at 360px, 390x844 and 1440x900 without horizontal overflow or browser page errors. All 18 feature destinations remain reachable. Home stack margin conflict corrected.

loading.evidence: Saved collection hydrates from device storage; browser waits for actual saved cards. Image frames reserve dimensions; final populated captures disable reveal animation.

empty.evidence: Fresh browser captures show empty saved collection and planner with Explore places recovery. Memories tab offers Create a memory.

error.evidence: Browser test replaces Storage.setItem with a throwing implementation, then clicks Add to my day and verifies could-not-save status.

partial.evidence: Three selected places with unknown hours render their photo rows. Make my plan exposes scheduling problems and suggested-trails recovery.

success.evidence: Bookmarks change to Remove bookmark, add-to-plan changes to View my day. Community follow, like and submitted comment verified in preview.

permission.reason: These styling and navigation changes introduce no permission request, authentication or upload. Existing camera and account flows remain separate destinations.
